design_principles: Shadow cohort (100%) and Live cohort (1%) are completely independent selections
Live cohort MUST be a strict subset of shadow cohort
Both salts are deterministic (SHA256-based stable_bucket) — no per-request randomness
Shadow eligibility is necessary but not sufficient for live eligibility
Live selection uses independent salt pi_live_v1 with 1% rollout threshold

live_cohort.proof: live_selected(r) = bucket(r, 'pi_live_v1') < 1.0% AND shadow_selected(r) = bucket(r, 'pi_v1') < 100.0% = True always; therefore live_selected ⊆ shadow_selected

selection_invariants.restart_stable: no state dependency; recomputed from same inputs
selection_invariants.cross_worker_stable: salt and rollout_percent in env vars, consistent across workers
selection_invariants.config_version_independence: cv changes do not affect salt; selection is cv-independent

arbitration_policy.invariant: exactly one user-visible assistant result per request

provider_mode.description: Pre-recorded Pi responses replayed from staging fixture corpus. No real LLM inference calls.
